author: Zegita
body:
So I've just been banned during a stream by a moderator called Fouled however, it was for "Excessive rude language" but I did not say anything rude during the stream and I have witnesses for that. May I have some explanation for this? I was streaming the all-star game and now nobody can watch it because I've been banned now.

Please can someone explain this where I've used excessive language in the stream. Many thanks

-Zegita

title: Banned during a stream

replies.author: Administrafer
replies.body:
Hello,
Your punishment will not be lifted as I have come across some inappropriate/aggressive content in your chat logs:
1. http://i.imgur.com/A1X5gXJ.png
2. http://i.imgur.com/yuufGeq.png
3. http://i.imgur.com/DOOaZ2t.png
You clearly violated the rules; therefore we recommend you wait the temporary ban out. 

Thanks.
